the_catch_that_mattered.what: the first dry run reconciled its bytes and came in under budget, and would still have shipped lm_head at cosine 0.683 against a null of 0.852 -- 18 tensors below their null carrying 17 percent of the activation-aware mass
the_catch_that_mattered.why_fatal: an lm_head below its null produces logits worse than the mean row, which is exactly Math-Preserve's failure mode
the_catch_that_mattered.fix: beats-null is now a hard allocation constraint; a tensor that cannot beat its null at any rank falls through to native
the_catch_that_mattered.cost_whole_model: ~0.04 BPW. Close to free at scale.

honest_projection.why_the_packer_underestimated: its model assumed fetch overlapped measurement. They are serial: each shard is fetched, then measured, then evicted. The 2.0 Gbit/s fetch figure was right; the overlap assumption was not.
